description: Represents a single AWS CodeBuild report, which is the test or code coverage result produced by one build run and stored in a report group.

S3ReportExportConfig.description: Information about the S3 bucket where the raw data of the report is exported.

Bucket.description: The name of the S3 bucket where the raw data of the report is exported.

BucketOwner.description: The account identifier of the owner of the S3 bucket. This allows the report to be exported to a bucket owned by another account.

Path.description: The path to the exported report's raw data results.

Packaging.description: The type of build output artifact to create. ZIP produces a ZIP file containing the raw data, and NONE produces individual files.

EncryptionKey.description: The encryption key for the report's encrypted raw data.

EncryptionDisabled.description: Whether the report's raw data is exported without encryption.

ReportExportConfig.description: Information about the location where the run of a report is exported.

ExportConfigType.description: The export configuration type. S3 exports the report's raw data to an S3 bucket, and NO_EXPORT means the report is not exported.

TestReportSummary.description: Information about a test report, present only when the report's type is TEST.

Total.description: The number of test cases in the report.

StatusCounts.description: The number of test cases in the report by status. The key is the test case status and the value is the number of test cases with that status.

DurationInNanoSeconds.description: The number of nanoseconds it took to run all of the test cases in the report.

CodeCoverageReportSummary.description: Information about a code coverage report, present only when the report's type is CODE_COVERAGE.

LineCoveragePercentage.description: The percentage of lines that are covered by the tests.

LinesCovered.description: The number of lines that are covered by the tests.

LinesMissed.description: The number of lines that are not covered by the tests.

BranchCoveragePercentage.description: The percentage of branches that are covered by the tests.

BranchesCovered.description: The number of conditional branches that are covered by the tests.

BranchesMissed.description: The number of conditional branches that are not covered by the tests.

Arn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the report run.

Type.description: The type of the report that was run. CODE_COVERAGE is a code coverage report and TEST is a test report. The value is not constrained to those two, because the service can return a report type that the public model does not declare.

Name.description: The name of the report that was run, which the service derives from the report group that contains it.

ReportGroupArn.description: The ARN of the report group associated with this report.

ExecutionId.description: The ARN of the build run that generated this report.

Status.description: The status of this report. A TEST report reaches SUCCEEDED, FAILED or INCOMPLETE, and a CODE_COVERAGE report reaches COMPLETE or INCOMPLETE. The value is not constrained to a fixed set, because the service returns statuses that the public model does not declare.

Created.description: The date and time this report run occurred, in ISO 8601 format.

Expired.description: The date and time a report expires, in ISO 8601 format. A report expires 30 days after it was run.

Truncated.description: Whether this report run is truncated. The list of test cases is truncated after the maximum number of test cases is reached.
